The major constituents of the slag glass are CaO, SiO2, Al2O3, and MgO. The composition lies around the 10% Al2O3 of the CaO-SiO2-Al2O3-MgO system, which corresponds to the primary field of melilite.

The glass composition is approximately 42% SiO2, 34% CaO, 11% MgO, 8% Al2O3, and 5% Fe2O3.
